== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Stellar Spear is a highly coveted weapon located within the [[Transcendent Ruins]], a site of immense power that attracts [[aura]] from its surroundings. It is considered a prize capable of elevating an entire faction to celestial status. Many seek the weapon for its potential to facilitate [[advancement]] beyond the [[Truegold]] realm, a leap that transcends common logic. For certain individuals, such as those within the [[Jai clan]], possessing the spear offers a method of [[advancement]] through the slaughter of specific [[blood]] members and the harvesting of their [[Remnants]]. The Stellar Spear is also a specialized [[Path]] utilized by the [[Jai clan]], a once-barbaric faction from the [[Desolate Wilds]] that became a dominant force through light-aspected combat techniques. This [[Path]] includes various [[Striker]] and [[Enforcer techniques]], such as the [[Star Lance]], Star's Edge{{!}}Star’s Edge, and the [[Hollow Spear]]. While the [[Path]] is associated with light and starlight-themed movements—often appearing as twisting lines or [[needles]] of light—it has also been subject to corruption and branching, such as the [[Path]] of the [[Broken Star]]. In terms of physical form, versions of the spear have been described as being crafted from [[madra]] by ancient [[Soulsmiths]], appearing as gleaming white weapons that resemble condensed starlight. Other iterations include weapons made of weathered sandstone with molten [[steel]] edges, or those featuring dark shafts and death-green chrome blades. The spear serves as a potent conductor for [[madra]], [[soulfire]], and [[willpower]], capable of delivering devastating strikes that can pierce hearts or destroy souls.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The Stellar Spear is a discipline that branches from the [[Path]] of the [[Broken Star]]. This path utilizes [[madra]] that is as sharp as an axe and white as snow, incorporating the [[Star's Edge]] [[technique]]. Although used by [[Jai Daishou]], the Stellar Spear lacks any [[Ruler techniques]] suited for battle.}}
